title: Residential parking permit renewal
summary: Renew a residential parking permit when the caller is verified and the permit, the resident account and the renewal window qualify.

rules.explain: The caller must give the date of birth on file before any change.
Only active permits can be renewed.
Residents owing more than 20.00 in unpaid parking fines cannot renew.
Renewal opens only 60 days before the permit expires.

policy_text:
## Who can ask
Residents can ask to renew a residential parking permit by phone or chat. Before changing anything, find the permit and the resident it belongs to, and confirm the caller's identity: the date of birth the caller gives must match the one on file. If it does not match, or the caller cannot give it, do not make any change. Never reveal the date of birth or other details on file.

## Finding the permit
Use the permit number if the resident has it. Otherwise find the permit by the vehicle licence plate registered on it, or find the resident by the email address on file and list their permits; ask which permit they mean if there is more than one. If the permit cannot be identified, explain that you cannot proceed and offer a transfer to a human agent.

## When a renewal is allowed
- The permit must have status active. Expired or revoked permits cannot be renewed (a new application is needed).
- Residents who owe more than 20.00 in unpaid parking fines cannot renew until they pay.
- Renewal opens 60 days before the expiry date. If the permit expires more than 60 days from today, decline; do not renew early.

The resident chooses a six-month or twelve-month renewal. If everything above is fine, renew the permit with the term they asked for. A six-month renewal adds 182 days to the current expiry date and a twelve-month renewal adds 365 days.

## Never
Do not waive or reduce fines, do not make exceptions to the renewal window, do not renew for a caller who failed the identity check, and do not change anything the resident did not ask for. Go by the records, not by what the caller believes they show.

cases.persona: Ivan, a delivery coordinator who is certain he paid every ticket he ever got.
cases.reason_for_call: His permit runs out soon and he wants to renew it.
cases.task_instructions: Start by asking for a twelve-month renewal, giving the permit number and your date of birth. Say you have no unpaid fines. Before anything is done, change your mind and ask for a six-month renewal instead. If the agent declines, accept it politely and end.

cases.persona: Hana, a graphic designer who writes very short messages.
cases.reason_for_call: She wants to renew her residential parking permit for a year.
cases.task_instructions: In your first message give the permit number, a twelve-month term and your date of birth in as few words as possible. Answer further questions with only a few words.

cases.persona: Tomas, a contractor in a hurry who hates extra questions.
cases.reason_for_call: He wants his permit renewed for six months before it lapses.
cases.task_instructions: Give the permit number and the six-month term at once. Show impatience at any verification question, complain briefly, but give your date of birth when the agent asks for it.

extra_details.text: She paid her last parking ticket in full back in April.
The permit is registered to her blue Honda Civic in zone D.

cases.persona: Priya, a pharmacist who is friendly and well organized.
cases.reason_for_call: She wants a full-year renewal of her parking permit.
cases.task_instructions: Explain your request in the first message with the permit number, the twelve-month term, your date of birth, and mention that your fines are paid and the permit is active. Mention the other helpful details naturally and answer questions politely.

cases.persona: Greg, calling from a borrowed phone after his renewal letter was thrown away; he does not remember his plate details on the permit or which email is registered.
cases.reason_for_call: He wants a twelve-month renewal of his parking permit.
cases.task_instructions: Say you want a twelve-month renewal and give your name. You do not have the permit number, cannot say which email is on file, and do not recall the plate registered. Answer in very few words and accept it if the agent cannot help.

cases.persona: Lucia, a university lecturer who is helpful and relaxed but never kept her permit paperwork.
cases.reason_for_call: She wants to renew her parking permit for six months but does not know the permit number.
cases.task_instructions: Say you want a six-month renewal, give the licence plate of your car and your date of birth. You do not know the permit number. Share your email if asked.

cases.persona: Samuel, a retired bus driver who likes to plan ahead.
cases.reason_for_call: He wants to renew his permit early so he does not forget.
cases.task_instructions: First ask for a twelve-month renewal and give your date of birth, but do not mention the permit number until the agent asks for it. Before anything is done, change your mind and ask for a six-month renewal instead. If the agent declines, accept it and end.

extra_details.text: She also has a second permit for her husband's car that is still valid.
She recently moved to a different flat in the same building.
She contested a parking ticket last year and won.
The city bins on her street are collected on Thursdays.

cases.persona: Elena, a restaurant manager who is busy, talkative and insistent.
cases.reason_for_call: She wants a twelve-month renewal of the permit for her own car, which she thinks just ran out.
cases.task_instructions: Ask for a twelve-month renewal of the permit with the number and your date of birth. Mention the side stories along the way. If the agent refuses, argue and ask for an exception at least twice before accepting.
